map.哈希把任意长度输入映射为定长摘要：MD5 输出 128 位（32 位十六进制）、: Hashing maps input of any length to a fixed-length digest: MD5 outputs 128 bits (32 hex characters), SHA-1 outputs 160 bits (40 hex characters), SHA-256 outputs 256 bits (64 hex characters); the digest is constant for the same input and a tiny change produces an avalanche effect (about half the bits flip); it suits integrity and consistency verification, but MD5 and SHA-1 already have collision risks, so security scenarios should use SHA-256 or above.

map.哈希将任意长度输入映射为固定长度摘要，单向不可逆、输入微小变化输出大不同（雪崩效: Hashing maps input of any length to a fixed-length digest, is one-way and irreversible, and a tiny input change produces a very different output (avalanche effect). MD5 outputs 128 bits (no longer recommended for security), SHA-1 outputs 160 bits (weakened), SHA-256 outputs 256 bits (currently recommended).
map.文本 hello 的 MD5 = 5d41402abc4b2a76b9719d9: The MD5 of the text hello is = 5d41402abc4b2a76b9719d911017c592 and its SHA-256 = 2cf24dba5fb0a30e26e83b2ac5b9e29e1b161e5c1fa7425e73043362938b9824; changing one character to hellp makes both hashes completely different, showing the avalanche effect.
map.哈希和加密有什么区别？: What is the difference between hashing and encryption?
map.哈希单向不可逆、用于校验；加密可逆、用于保密。验证文件用哈希比对，保护内容用加密: Hashing is one-way and irreversible, used for verification; encryption is reversible and used for confidentiality. Use hash comparison to verify files and encryption to protect content.
map.为什么不用 MD5 做安全校验？: Why not use MD5 for security verification?
map.MD5/SHA-1 已被找到碰撞攻击，可构造不同文件同哈希；安全场景请用 SHA: Collision attacks have been found for MD5/SHA-1, so different files can be constructed with the same hash; use SHA-256 or stronger in security scenarios.
